name: Ableton Push
summary: Ableton Push: the software side of Ableton’s Push hardware, with the Push 3 firmware update, the recovery image, the Windows USB audio drivers and the GPL source code.
description:
Push is Ableton’s hardware instrument and controller. Push 3 can run on its own in Standalone Mode or work as a controller for Live, and its release notes follow the Live release they ship with.
This page tracks the downloads for Push: the Push 3 firmware update and recovery image, the USB audio drivers for Windows (the current driver and the legacy driver) and the GPL source code Ableton publishes for Push 3. The changelog is Ableton’s Push release notes, which are numbered alongside Live (for example Push 2.4.16 with Live 12.4.16).
Only the newest Push release has downloads of its own. Earlier releases are described in the changelog text.

license.name: Proprietary (Ableton End User License Agreement); GPL source code published for Push 3

versions.release_notes:
No specific updates for Push.

Push 2.4.15 with Live 12.4.15 (2026-10-28)
New Features and Improvements
Devices

- Improved consistency of display names for LFO parameters across devices.

MIDI Tools

- Notes generated by the Seed or Rhythm MIDI Tools now have a release velocity value of 64.

Push 3 Standalone Mode Only

- Audio input channels 1-2 on Push are now unmuted when switching to Standalone Mode without the need to unmute them in Control Mode.

Bugfixes
Live Bugfixes

- Improved CPU performance when Show Tempo Follower Toggle is set to Hide in the Tempo & MIDI Settings.

Push 1 Bugfixes

- Fixed a crash that occurred when attempting to show a notification about selecting the playing clip using the up or down arrow button.

- Push 2 firmware updates are now working correctly again.

- Fixed a bug that caused a macOS dialog requesting command line developer tools installation to appear when Push was connected to Live.

- Fixed an issue where the Amp's Input Gain parameter was not affected as expected by the XYZ layout.

Push 2 and 3 Bugfixes

- Fixed a bug where Vinyl Distortion's Pinch Stereo/Mono mode selection was inverted on Push.

- Fixed an issue where Push 2 and 3 would freeze when using Auto Shift.

Push 3 Standalone Mode Only Bugfixes

- Fixed an issue where using the Allen & Heath CQ-18T as an external sound card with Push 3 Standalone Mode would cause audio dropouts or disturbances.

- It is no longer possible to log in via SSH using the default passwords when the unit is in recovery mode.

Push 2.4.7 with Live 12.4.7 (2026-10-22)
New Features and Improvements

- Added Control Surface support for the Akai MPK Mini Plus II.

Push 2.4.6 with Live 12.4.6 (2026-09-15)
No specific updates for Push.

Push 2.4.5 with Live 12.4.5 (2026-08-26)
New Features and Improvements
Max for Live

- Updated Max 9.1.5 to 3db35fa:

- MIDI: improved recovery from bad bytes

- Parameters: fixed param visibility getting stuck after saving in Live

Bugfixes
Push Bugfixes

- Fixed a crash that could occur when trying to delete a MIDI mapping from Push.

- Fixed an issue with icons in lists, such as the list of effect types in the FX Type parameter in Drum Sampler, where icons would disappear after touching the encoder.

- Fixed a crash that occurred when attempting to show a notification about selecting the playing clip using the up or down arrow button.

Push 2.4.3 with Live 12.4.3 (2026-07-14)
New Features and Improvements
Push 2 and 3

- It is now possible to toggle the context menu options "Enable Per-Note Pitch Bend" and "Pitch > Env" for Drum Sampler directly from Push.

Push 3

- Two new parameters have been added to the Preferences tab of the Setup menu: Play Modifier and Recording. When Play Modifier is set to Off, the Play button triggers playback on press and no longer acts as a modifier for Follow Actions. When Recording is set to Selected Track, pressing Record starts recording only on the selected track rather than on all armed tracks.

Bugfixes
Push 3

- Updated the Push 3 firmware package from 1.5.0 to 1.5.4. This update includes the following changes:

- On macOS Tahoe, fixed an issue with audio clock source setting when Push is in Control Mode.

- Improved the audio streams’ resilience to short-term electromagnetic interferences.

- Switching between volume options with the Volume encoder now takes effect on pressing instead of releasing the encoder.

- It is now more likely for units to run when powered with a 15W USB-C power source, depending on the cable and host power quality.

- Fixed an issue with LEDs slightly flashing while booting.

Push 3 Standalone Mode Only

- Fixed an issue where an unrelated error message was shown if the track limit for Live Intro was reached on Push 3 Standalone. Now, an error message related to the exact issue is displayed.

- The Latency control for Link Audio can now be adjusted in increments of +/-10 ms via the encoder in the Status tab. This makes it easier to set higher latency values.

Push Bugfixes

- Fixed an issue where the display color for the Delete Map button was not updated to indicate the button could be used to delete a newly added MIDI mapping.

- Fixed an issue where it was not possible to adjust the Global Groove amount in fine increments by holding Shift if the Setup menu was open.

- Fixed a regression where the Rename option appeared in the context menu for clips, scenes, and tracks on Push 2. Now, the Rename option is not shown as renaming is only done in Live directly when using Push 2.

- Fixed a bug where it was possible to access the Rhythm Generator layout when using Live Intro on Push, even though that layout is not part of the Intro feature set. Now, the Rhythm Generator layout is only accessible when a valid Live edition is authorized.

- Fixed an issue where it was not possible to use MPE Slide with an MPE Drum Kit when the Rhythm Generator layout was selected.

- It is now required to have the power supply connected when updating Push's firmware. Previously, some tethered units were unable to reboot after a firmware update because they were only powered via USB-C.

- Fixed a bug where the clip context menu was shown if a clip was selected after locking and unlocking the Session Overview via the Shift and Layout buttons, as though the Shift button were still being held.

- Fixed an issue where the Wi-Fi settings were shown in the Status tab of the Setup…

Push 2.4.2 with Live 12.4.2 (2026-06-11)
New Features and Improvements

- Added Control Surface support for the Arturia MiniLab 37.

Bugfixes

- Fixed an issue with the sound of the Delay preset Tape Warble.

No specific updates for Push.
